security.title: Security and compliance
security.description: How Artemis protects your funds, your cards and your data.
security.headline: Built so that no agent can act on its own.
security.lead: The worst case, an agent manipulated by a prompt injection, is contained by the card itself.

funds.title: Your funds never leave your bank
funds.body: Artemis is software. Cards are issued by your own provider (Qonto, Revolut Business, Stripe) on your account. We do not hold, receive or transfer any funds.

defense.title: Defense in depth
defense.i1: Single-use card, capped at the exact approved amount.
defense.i3: Rules per agent: budget, limit, merchants, categories.
defense.i4: Automatic reconciliation, with an alert on any amount or merchant mismatch.
defense.i5: “Freeze everything” button: agents suspended and active cards cancelled in one click.
defense.i6: Agents can only ask: no MCP tool can change a rule or approve a payment.

cardNumbers.title: Card numbers
cardNumbers.body: By default, the full card number and security code never go through Artemis: the agent receives a short-lived, single-use link (10 minutes) and the card is displayed by the issuing bank (Stripe Issuing Elements). Direct delivery is available as an advanced option, off by default; even then, nothing is stored.

mandates.title: Signed mandates
mandates.body: Every approval is a WebAuthn (passkey) signature over the SHA-256 hash of the mandate: agent, amount, currency, merchant, purpose, expiry. The audit log is hash-chained and append-only: any tampering can be detected.

aiAct.title: AI Act and human oversight
aiAct.body: The EU AI Act requires deployers to log and oversee their systems. The Artemis log, which you can export, records who authorized each agent payment, when, and under which rules.

data.title: Personal data
data.body: Database hosted in the European Union (Supabase, Frankfurt). Bank credentials encrypted (AES-256-GCM). See the privacy policy.

report.title: Report a vulnerability
report.body: Write to the address given in the legal notice. We reply within 72 hours.
